alice.tucson.api
Interface TucsonContext

All Known Implementing Classes:
DefaultContextStub
public interface TucsonContext

Interface of any TuCSoN agent coordination context An agent coordination context defines (and enables) the actions that an agent can do on by means of a coordination medium.
